extraction.name: PIQA: Reasoning about Physical Commonsense in Natural Language
extraction.description: A benchmark dataset for physical commonsense reasoning in natural language understanding, focusing on everyday situations with atypical solutions.
extraction.creator: Yonatan Bisk, Rowan Zellers, Ronan Le Bras, Jianfeng Gao, Yejin Choi
extraction.publisher: Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected through human annotation inspired by instructables.com, where annotators provided physical goals and solutions, with semantic perturbations to create incorrect alternatives.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Instructables.com as a source of physical commonsense instructions.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Annotators were asked to provide semantic perturbations or alternative approaches to create incorrect solutions that are syntactically and topically similar.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data was cleaned using the AFLite algorithm to remove annotation artifacts and trivial examples. Examples with low agreement during validation were removed.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators provided physical goals and solutions inspired by instructables.com, with tricks to create incorrect alternatives. Validation was performed to remove low-agreement examples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: During validation, examples with low agreement were removed. Annotator pay averaged >15$/hr.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Spacy for tokenization, AFLite algorithm for bias reduction.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Discusses the challenge of AI systems learning physical commonsense without experiencing the physical world, with implications for robotics and natural language understanding.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Reporting bias was addressed by using instructables.com to inspire atypical solutions and flatten the distribution of referenced objects. AFLite was used to remove stylistic artifacts and trivial examples.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dataset may contain examples that require expert knowledge, which were removed during validation. Models struggle with subtle physical concepts and non-prototypical situations.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, testing, and validation of natural language understanding models for physical commonsense reasoning. Usage includes benchmarking progress in this domain.
